Validation refuses a reference in an action step's params.actor (action_actor_not_literal): the node routes on the value as written, so the committed bundle's inputs.actor failed actor_unavailable live; the discord-library bundle now reads as discord-bot by id and pushes kind discord-message, and tests/rules/test_discord_library_bundle.py runs it end to end on doubles (10 tests, red on the old bundle, green on the new)

After /code-review of PR #100, b3 widens: the literal-actor check (action_model actor_problem, one reference scanner) covers a rule's action and on_failure as well as action steps, refuses non-string and empty ids and {"$literal": ...}, reports an input-reference actor once (not also action_step_ref), and is save-time only (dropped in stored mode like the catalog codes, so documents stored earlier still load and run); the editor guides action_actor_not_literal with Pick an actor; the discord-library bundle rule runs only on discord-bot's events (condition data.actor == discord-bot), and the bundle test tells the two bots apart by grant
